raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

LLaDA-Image serving has no cookbook page yet. The Supported Models catalog lists neither registered checkpoint, and the server's startup log already points users to the model's cookbook page for memory guidance.

## Changes

- Add `docs/cookbook/diffusion/inclusionAI/LLaDA-Image.mdx` with its command builder config `docs/src/snippets/configs/inclusionAI/llada-image.jsx`, following the diffusion page layout, including the ComfyUI section.
- The builder serves Base and Turbo on one GPU and pins the validated checkpoint revisions beside `--trust-remote-code`, because both checkpoints load remote configuration code.
- The builder shows the Python command, as the Ming-Image page does, and Quick start points to a nightly Docker image or a source install. Editing uploads the source image, so a Docker run needs no extra mount.
- Add a LLaDA-Image navigation group next to Ming-Image, an overview card, and a Supported Models row for `inclusionAI/LLaDA-Image` and `inclusionAI/LLaDA-Image-Turbo`, and move the NEW tag from Ming-Image to this page.
- The page builds on @Anmuliar's original cookbook draft, whose commit keeps its authorship.

## Validation

```bash Command
node docs/scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs
node --test docs/scripts/tests/*.test.mjs
cd docs && mint validate && mint broken-links --check-anchors --check-redirects
```

All of them pass. The builder's Serve command started both checkpoints, and its generation and edit requests and the page's Python examples returned valid 1024 by 1024 images. Sizes off the 16 or 32 pixel grid, text encoder offload, FP8 quantization, and Cache-DiT are refused with an explicit error.

## Performance

Measured on one H200 with BF16 weights at 1024 by 1024, using the builder's commands. Each cell is the median client wall time of 40 sequential requests, ten in each of four fresh server processes after two warmups.

| Task | Turbo, 4 steps, CFG 1 | Base, 50 steps, CFG 5 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Text to image | 0.5783 s | 13.0801 s |
| Image editing | 1.4240 s | 31.3271 s |

## Accuracy Tests

Scored with BF16 weights at 1024 by 1024 using the builder's commands. GenEval uses 553 prompts with seeds 42 to 45 and its Mask2Former detector. LongText-Bench uses 160 English and 160 Chinese prompts with seeds 42 to 45 and Qwen2.5-VL-7B OCR. CVTG-2K uses 2000 prompts with seed 42 and reports OCR word accuracy. Base uses 50 steps for LongText-Bench and 20 steps for GenEval and CVTG-2K. LongText-Bench scores move by about 0.001 between evaluator runs because its OCR model samples.

| Benchmark | Turbo, 4 steps, CFG 1 | Base, CFG 5 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GenEval | 0.8250 | 0.8361 |
| LongText English | 0.8974 | 0.9189 |
| LongText Chinese | 0.9228 | 0.9103 |
| CVTG-2K word accuracy | 0.8236 | 0.7805 |

@@ -0,0 +1,190 @@ +--- +title: LLaDA-Image +tag: NEW +description: "Deploy LLaDA-Image Base and Turbo with SGLang Diffusion for text-to-image generation and single-image editing with English and Chinese text rendering." +--- + +import { DiffusionModelTags } from '/src/snippets/diffusion/model-tags.jsx' +import { Deployment } from '/src/snippets/_deployment.jsx' +import { config } from '/src/snippets/configs/inclusionAI/llada-image.jsx' + + + +## 1. Quick start + +Use a nightly Docker image containing this integration, or install from source, following the [SGLang Diffusion installation guide](/docs/sglang-diffusion/installation). Run the commands below inside that environment, then pick a checkpoint and request mode. + + + + +Both checkpoints load configuration code from their Hugging Face repositories. Keep `--trust-remote-code` together with the commit-pinned `--revision` that the builder emits, and review the remote code before moving to another revision. + + +## 2. Model capabilities + +[LLaDA-Image](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/LLaDA-Image) is a 6B-parameter image generation and editing family. It generates images from text and edits one reference image from an instruction. Prompts are encoded by an embedded LLaDA 2.0 mixture-of-experts language model, and the model is designed for rendering English and Chinese text inside the image. + +Choose Base for the highest fidelity and Turbo, distilled to four steps without CFG, for interactive serving. SGLang serves both checkpoints in BF16 on one GPU. Multi-GPU sequence parallelism, FP8 checkpoints, and the model card's VQ-conditioned generation mode are not served by this integration. + +## 3. Deployment details + +### Checkpoint selection + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + +
CheckpointBest fitDefault samplingValidated revision
inclusionAI/LLaDA-ImageMaximum fidelity50 steps, CFG 5e4e2703f
inclusionAI/LLaDA-Image-TurboLowest latency4 steps, CFG 1f4afc52d
+ +Each checkpoint applies its own sampling defaults, so requests may omit `num_inference_steps` and `guidance_scale`. Values a request sets explicitly take precedence. + +### Serving topology + +One server handles both `/v1/images/generations` and `/v1/images/edits`, so editing needs no second deployment. The verified recipe runs on one GPU with TP 1 and no sequence parallelism. The embedded text encoder stays resident on the GPU next to the DiT, and the server used about 51 GiB of GPU memory throughout the 1024 by 1024 measurements below, for either checkpoint. The server refuses multi-GPU launches, text encoder offload, quantized checkpoints, and Cache-DiT at startup with an explicit error. + +## 4. Request examples + +The Request tab of the builder emits the matching cURL command for generation or editing. The Python examples below use the OpenAI client with Turbo. Switch the model to `inclusionAI/LLaDA-Image` and restart the server with the Base command to use Base, and the server applies the Base sampling defaults. + + +```python Text-to-image +import base64 +from openai import OpenAI + +client = OpenAI(api_key="EMPTY", base_url="http://127.0.0.1:30000/v1") +response = client.images.generate( + model="inclusionAI/LLaDA-Image-Turbo", + prompt="A bilingual bookstore poster reading '星河书店' and 'Starlight Books'", + size="1024x1024", + n=1, + response_format="b64_json", + extra_body={"seed": 42}, +) + +with open("llada-image.png", "wb") as output: + output.write(base64.b64decode(response.data[0].b64_json)) +``` + +```python Single-image editing +import base64 +from openai import OpenAI + +client = OpenAI(api_key="EMPTY", base_url="http://127.0.0.1:30000/v1") +with open("input.png", "rb") as source: + response = client.images.edit( + model="inclusionAI/LLaDA-Image-Turbo", + image=source, + prompt="Place the subject on a beach at golden hour.", + size="1024x1024", + n=1, + response_format="b64_json", + extra_body={"seed": 42}, + ) + +with open("llada-image-edit.png", "wb") as output: + output.write(base64.b64decode(response.data[0].b64_json)) +``` + + +## 5. Feature details + +### Request limits + +Generation width and height must be multiples of 16, and editing width and height must be multiples of 32. Editing takes exactly one uploaded image or image URL. An edit also has to fit the model's limit of 32,768 sequence positions for the source image, the output, and the prompt, so with a short prompt the largest square edit is 1888 by 1888, and larger edits fail. A request may ask for up to 10 outputs, which are generated one after another. Invalid sizes are rejected with HTTP 400 before inference. + +### H200 performance + +These measurements use one H200 with BF16 weights, 1024 by 1024 output, and the Serve command and requests that the builder generates. Each cell is the median client wall time of 40 sequential requests, ten in each of four fresh server processes after two warmup requests. Turbo uses 4 steps with CFG 1, and Base uses 50 steps with CFG 5. + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + +
TaskTurbo SP1Base SP1
Text to image0.5783 s13.0801 s
Image editing1.4240 s31.3271 s
+ +### Quality validation + +These scores use the same one-GPU BF16 servers and 1024 by 1024 output. GenEval scores 2212 images per checkpoint (553 prompts, seeds 42 to 45) with its Mask2Former object detector. LongText-Bench scores 1280 images per checkpoint (160 English and 160 Chinese prompts, seeds 42 to 45) by OCR with Qwen2.5-VL-7B. CVTG-2K scores 2000 images per checkpoint (seed 42) by OCR word accuracy. Turbo uses 4 steps with CFG 1. Base uses CFG 5 with 50 steps for LongText-Bench and 20 steps for GenEval and CVTG-2K. The LongText-Bench OCR model samples, so its scores move by about 0.001 between evaluator runs. + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + +
BenchmarkTurbo SP1Base SP1
GenEval0.82500.8361
LongText English0.89740.9189
LongText Chinese0.92280.9103
CVTG-2K word accuracy0.82360.7805
+ +### Unsupported controls + +Cache-DiT is rejected at server startup and per request. Text encoder offload, multi-GPU launches, and quantized checkpoints are rejected at server startup. The default eager path does not use approximate caching, quantized attention, or CUDA graphs. Other attention backends and GPU families were not measured end to end, so this page keeps the platform default. + +## 6. Run in ComfyUI + +import { ComfyUISupport } from '/src/snippets/diffusion/comfyui-support.jsx' + +

+// LLaDA-Image command builder for SGLang Diffusion.
+//
+// Both checkpoints load remote configuration code, so every generated command
+// keeps --trust-remote-code beside the commit-pinned --revision that was
+// validated end to end on one H200.
+
+export const config = {
+  modelName: "LLaDA-Image",
+  supportedHardware: ["h200"],
+  groupHardware: false,
+  matchDims: [],
+
+  checkpoints: {
+    base: {
+      model: "inclusionAI/LLaDA-Image",
+      revision: "e4e2703f410f7ddb6ee8d6b09dac6a8ec5093039",
+    },
+    turbo: {
+      model: "inclusionAI/LLaDA-Image-Turbo",
+      revision: "f4afc52d925bbac4e22a1c947111fc1f127e37e5",
+    },
+  },
+
+  overlayDims: [
+    {
+      id: "weights",
+      title: "Checkpoint",
+      scope: "base",
+      description:
+        "Base favors fidelity with 50 steps and CFG 5. Turbo is distilled to 4 steps without CFG. Each checkpoint applies its own sampling defaults.",
+      default: "turbo",
+      learnMore: "#checkpoint-selection",
+      options: [
+        { id: "base", label: "Base", subtitle: "50 steps, CFG 5" },
+        { id: "turbo", label: "Turbo", subtitle: "4 steps, CFG 1", recommended: true },
+      ],
+    },
+    {
+      id: "mode",
+      title: "Request mode",
+      scope: "base",
+      description:
+        "One server handles both endpoints. Editing takes exactly one source image.",
+      default: "generate",
+      options: [
+        { id: "generate", label: "Text to image", recommended: true },
+        { id: "edit", label: "Image editing" },
+      ],
+    },
+    {
+      id: "placement",
+      title: "Placement",
+      scope: "serve",
+      description:
+        "The embedded LLaDA 2.0 MoE text encoder stays resident on the GPU.",
+      default: "resident",
+      learnMore: "#unsupported-controls",
+      options: [
+        { id: "resident", label: "Resident", recommended: true },
+        {
+          id: "encoder-offload",
+          label: "Text encoder offload",
+          disabled: true,
+          disableReason:
+            "LLaDA-Image refuses text encoder offload at startup because the embedded encoder must stay resident.",
+        },
+      ],
+    },
+    {
+      id: "outputs",
+      title: "Outputs",
+      scope: "request",
+      description:
+        "Outputs of one request are generated in sequence. The verified request returns one image.",
+      kind: "number",
+      min: 1,
+      max: 10,
+      unit: "outputs per prompt",
+      default: 1,
+      options: [],
+    },
+  ],
+
+  commandBuilder: {
+    defaultSelection: {
+      hw: "h200",
+      nodes: 1,
+      gpus_per_node: 1,
+      topology_mode: "auto",
+      tp_size: 1,
+      ulysses_degree: 1,
+      ring_degree: 1,
+    },
+    resource: {
+      limits: {
+        nodes: { min: 1, max: 1 },
+        gpus_per_node: { min: 1, max: 1 },
+      },
+      verifiedRecipes: [
+        {
+          id: "h200-1gpu",
+          hw: "h200",
+          nodes: 1,
+          gpus_per_node: 1,
+          placement: "resident",
+          tp_size: 1,
+          ulysses_degree: 1,
+          ring_degree: 1,
+          default: true,
+        },
+      ],
+      autoTopology: () => ({ tp_size: 1, ulysses_degree: 1, ring_degree: 1 }),
+      validateTopology: (s, topology) => {
+        const errors = []
+        if (Number(s.nodes) !== 1 || Number(s.gpus_per_node) !== 1) {
+          errors.push("LLaDA-Image serves on one GPU and refuses multi-GPU launches at startup.")
+        }
+        if ([topology.tp_size, topology.ulysses_degree, topology.ring_degree].some((n) => Number(n) !== 1)) {
+          errors.push("LLaDA-Image requires TP 1, Ulysses 1, and Ring 1.")
+        }
+        return errors
+      },
+    },
+    resolveDeployment: (s) => {
+      const resource = config.commandBuilder.resource
+      const topology = s.topology_mode === "manual"
+        ? {
+            tp_size: Number(s.tp_size),
+            ulysses_degree: Number(s.ulysses_degree),
+            ring_degree: Number(s.ring_degree),
+          }
+        : resource.autoTopology(s)
+      const errors = resource.validateTopology(s, topology)
+      const checkpoint = config.checkpoints[s.weights] || config.checkpoints.turbo
+      const recipe = resource.verifiedRecipes.find((entry) => entry.hw === s.hw
+        && entry.nodes === Number(s.nodes)
+        && entry.gpus_per_node === Number(s.gpus_per_node)
+        && entry.placement === s.placement
+        && entry.tp_size === topology.tp_size
+        && entry.ulysses_degree === topology.ulysses_degree
+        && entry.ring_degree === topology.ring_degree)
+      const serveVerified = !!recipe && errors.length === 0
+      const requestVerified = serveVerified && Number(s.outputs) === 1
+      const flags = [
+        "--trust-remote-code",
+        `--model-path ${checkpoint.model}`,
+        `--revision ${checkpoint.revision}`,
+        "--host {{HOST_IP}}",
+        "--port {{PORT}}",
+      ]
+      return {
+        match: { hw: s.hw },
+        nnodes: 1,
+        verified: requestVerified,
+        flags,
+        builder: {
+          topology,
+          topologySummary: "TP 1, Ulysses 1, Ring 1, one GPU",
+          errors,
+          warnings: errors.length || requestVerified
+            ? []
+            : ["Only one output per request was measured end to end."],
+          verification: {
+            serve: errors.length ? "error" : (serveVerified ? "verified" : "unverified"),
+            request: errors.length ? "error" : (requestVerified ? "verified" : "unverified"),
+          },
+          resolvedSettings: {
+            placement: "Resident",
+            precision: "BF16",
+            encoder: "LLaDA 2.0 MoE, resident",
+          },
+        },
+      }
+    },
+  },
+
+  modelNames: { default: "inclusionAI/LLaDA-Image-Turbo" },
+
+  // No published image carries this integration yet, so only the Python run
+  // mode is shown. After an end-to-end Docker run: drop `runModes` and point
+  // dockerImages at that tag. Editing uploads the source image in the request
+  // body, so the server container needs no extra mount.
+  runModes: ["python"],
+  dockerImages: {
+    h200: "lmsysorg/sglang:dev",
+  },
+
+  placeholders: {
+    HOST_IP: { target: "command", label: "Bind host", default: "0.0.0.0" },
+    PORT: { target: "command", label: "Bind port", default: "30000" },
+    CURL_HOST: { target: "curl", label: "Server host", default: "localhost" },
+    CURL_PORT: { target: "curl", label: "Server port", default: "30000" },
+    INPUT_IMAGE: { target: "curl", label: "Source image on the client", default: "input.png" },
+  },
+
+  curl: (s) => {
+    const checkpoint = config.checkpoints[s.weights] || config.checkpoints.turbo
+    if (s.mode === "edit") {
+      return `curl -sS --fail-with-body http://{{CURL_HOST}}:{{CURL_PORT}}/v1/images/edits \\
+  -F 'image=@{{INPUT_IMAGE}}' \\
+  -F 'model=${checkpoint.model}' \\
+  -F 'prompt=Place the subject on a beach at golden hour.' \\
+  -F 'size=1024x1024' \\
+  -F 'n=${Number(s.outputs)}' \\
+  -F 'response_format=b64_json'`
+    }
+    const request = {
+      model: checkpoint.model,
+      prompt: "A cinematic photograph of a red fox standing in fresh snow at golden hour, detailed fur, shallow depth of field",
+      size: "1024x1024",
+      n: Number(s.outputs),
+      response_format: "b64_json",
+    }
+    return `curl -sS --fail-with-body http://{{CURL_HOST}}:{{CURL_PORT}}/v1/images/generations \\
+  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
+  -d '${JSON.stringify(request, null, 2)}'`
+  },
+  showPlaygroundLink: false,
+  cells: [],
+}
